method: Actual React renderer hosted by Vite in isolated Electron with synthetic bridge, catalog, audio events and disposable userData. No live Jellyfin or provider writes.
checks: Off exhausts a finite queue without library discovery
Library discovery pages 620 songs, preserves queued prefix and planned shuffle suffix
Three shuffled 120-song cycles visit every song exactly once, with no immediate boundary repeats
Repeat one restarts natural completion while explicit Next advances
Slow library discovery joins at queue boundary instead of looping a one-song selection
Library failure leaves current audio alone and retry resumes a waiting boundary
Switching repeat off rejects delayed catalog results
Replacing the queue during discovery keeps the replacement prefix and current track
Single-song library repeats without exhaustion
Session restore retains repeat mode, canonical queue and planned suffix
Near-tail shuffle refill preserves its remaining suffix
Off shuffle exhausts all 120 songs exactly once
Sequential library mode plays the queue then library additions in order and wraps
Removed library song stays removed at the next boundary
Same-account library scope change cancels prior paging
Account switch rejects delayed catalog results
Oversized catalog produces a recoverable notice without discarding the playing queue
Changing selected libraries during a waiting natural boundary resumes with the new scope
Changing repeat off then on cancels a waiting natural boundary without phantom playback
Empty catalog preserves a playable explicit queue
Library retry returns keyboard focus to repeat control on success
Repeat icon cycles off to all to one to off without opening a menu
Enter and Space cycle the repeat icon and retain button focus
Icon and focus ring fit at both window sizes at 200 percent zoom
quality: pnpm run check: format, type-aware lint, TypeScript, voice asset validation, production build
limitations: Catalog is loaded once per repeat-mode/library-scope session, capped at the existing 100000-track persistence limit. No large-library performance benchmark.

Mocked media events and bridge responses exercise renderer behavior; real Jellyfin pagination, actual decoded audio completion, native encrypted persistence and audible DJ transitions were not exercised in this change.
Explicit duplicate queue occurrences are preserved. Catalog additions are deduplicated by song ID.

review.Steve: Accepted after repeat-mode and same-account library-scope boundary races were fixed and reproduced in native renderer checks.
